title: Yijing returns to Tang territory
shortSummary: Around 695, Yijing's return brought maritime travel experience into translation, writing and institutional networks.
curatorialDescription: The return links route and textual production; arrival city and subsequent itinerary remain to be separated.
researchNote: Arrival place, entry into Luoyang and translation projects require biographical and catalogue verification.
